summary: Procure Doccano annotation platform seats + Okta SSO/SCIM onboarding for Data Labeling team
description: Issue summary: The Data Labeling team requests enterprise licenses for Doccano (annotation tool) to support a quarterly ramp in annotation capacity. Impact: Without additional seats and SSO integration, the team cannot meet labeling SLAs for the new ground-truth project (estimated 120k labeled items over Q2). Request: Purchase 40 Doccano enterprise seats (annual) with Okta SSO/SCIM provisioning and a DPA. Include onboarding support (1-day remote) and priority support during initial migration. Business justification: Labels required for two critical production models; delays will push model launch and increase contract costs with external vendors. Cost center: ML Platform (CC: ML-2201). Desired start date: 2026-04-01. Approval: Needs Finance and Legal signoff for contract and DPA. Vendor notes: Doccano is an established annotation vendor but requires explicit SOC2 and data-handling confirmation for our PII workflows. Attachments/links: vendor quote (confluence:/confluence/doccano/quotes/quote-0326), vendor security questionnaire (confluence:/confluence/doccano/security-q-0326).
requested_items: Signed DPA and standard enterprise contract
steps_to_provision: Procurement: finalize PO and vendor contact; confirm billing method (invoiced via AP) and contract term
Legal: review and sign DPA and master services agreement
Security: review SOC2 + run quick DPIA for PII handling; confirm encryption at rest/in transit
IT: create enterprise Doccano org, enable Okta SSO, configure SCIM group mappings for ML-Labelers group
Onboarding: schedule 1-day session with Doccano Solutions and invite labeling leads
Operational: tag licenses in internal asset inventory and update cost reporting
